name: Jehoiachin
bio: Jehoiachin succeeded his father Jehoiakim as king of Judah at eighteen, reigning only three months in Jerusalem; his mother was Nehushta, daughter of Elnathan. He did evil in the LORD's eyes like his father. Nebuchadnezzar's forces besieged Jerusalem, and Jehoiachin surrendered himself, his mother, his officials, and his princes to the king of Babylon in Nebuchadnezzar's eighth year. Nebuchadnezzar stripped the temple and palace treasures, destroyed Solomon's gold vessels, and deported Jehoiachin along with the royal family, officials, craftsmen, and thousands of leading citizens to Babylon, installing his uncle Mattaniah (renamed Zedekiah) as king in his place (2 Kings 24:8-17). His own fate in exile is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
